# 易緯坤靈圖

**ID:** KR1a0170
**Custom ID:** ZB1a0167
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V53.11, p909
**Extent:** 1 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 鄭玄 (漢朝) 註

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The eighth and final of the eight *Yì wěi* 易緯 texts gathered as appendix to the *Yì*-class of the *Sìkù quánshū*; see [KR1a0163](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0163) for the broader contextualization of the *Yì wěi* tradition. One juàn. The work treats the spirit-charts (*líng tú* 靈圖) of *Kūn* as a divinatory-cosmographic apparatus complementary to the *Qián záo dù* / *Kūn záo dù* pair (the *Záo dù* tradition is methodologically focused on the chiseling-open of *Qián-Kūn*; the *Líng tú* on the spirit-mediated charts that derive from *Kūn*).

The *Yǒnglè dàdiǎn* recovery brings the *Sìkù*'s eight-text *Yì wěi* corpus to completion: the *Záo dù* pair ([KR1a0163](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0163) *Qián Kūn záo dù* + [KR1a0166](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0166) *Zhōuyì Qián záo dù*); the calendrical-divinatory pair ([KR1a0164](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0164) *Jī lǎn tú* + [KR1a0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0167) *Tōng guà yàn*); the cosmological pair ([KR1a0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0168) *Qián yuán xù zhì jì* + [KR1a0170](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0170) *Kūn líng tú*); and two miscellaneous works ([KR1a0165](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0165) *Biàn zhōng bèi* + [KR1a0169](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0169) *Shì lèi móu*).

**Abstract**

The work is the closing member of the *Sìkù*-recovered *Yì wěi* corpus, a compact one-juàn document on the spirit-mediated charts of *Kūn*. As with the broader corpus, the substantive content concerns Hàn-period (or post-Hàn-but-medieval) divinatory-cosmographic apparatus; the Zhèng Xuán-commentary attribution is conventional and not secure.
